description: This file contains utility functions for handling selectors, attribute matching, and text content extraction within a web automation or testing framework, specifically for Playwright. It includes functions for matching component attributes, processing element text, and retrieving ARIA labels.

methods.name: matchesComponentAttribute
methods.description: Checks if an object matches a component attribute based on a JSON path and attribute conditions.

methods.name: matchesAttributePart
methods.description: Determines if a value matches a given attribute selector part, supporting various operators.

methods.name: shouldSkipForTextMatching
methods.description: Decides whether an element should be skipped during text matching, such as script or style tags.

methods.name: elementText
methods.description: Extracts and caches the full, normalized, and immediate text content of an element or shadow root.

methods.name: elementMatchesText
methods.description: Checks if an element's text content matches a given text matcher, considering its children and shadow DOM.

methods.name: getElementLabels
methods.description: Retrieves accessible labels for an element via ARIA attributes or associated label elements.
